items.t: 9th Circuit questions DOJ demand to set aside 20,000 California mail ballots
items.x: A panel of federal appellate judges is questioning the Justice Department's demand that California election officials set aside thousands of mail ballots.

items.t: Brewers manager says of flight piloted by pitcher's uncle: 'I didn’t know Quinn threw a knuckleball'
items.x: Milwaukee Brewers manager Pat Murphy was quick with a quip for the pilot crew of the charter flight that brought the team to Florida for World Series Game 3.

items.t: Attackers kill nurse, severely injure health worker responding to Ebola case in eastern Congo
items.x: The World Health Organization reports that a nurse has been killed and a health worker severely injured in an attack while responding to an Ebola alert in Congo.

items.t: Luka Doncic scores NBA season-high 52 points in the Lakers' victory over the Jazz
items.x: Luka Doncic scored 52 points to lead the Los Angeles Lakers to a 132-123 victory over the Utah Jazz on Sunday.

items.t: Lions beat Packers 20-17 on last-play field goal to bail out Dan Campbell's failed 4th-down gamble
items.x: Jake Bates made a 22-yard field goal as time expired to give the Detroit Lions a 20-17 win over the Green Bay Packers on Sunday.

items.t: Vance no longer a hurricane but as a tropical storm still threatens Mexico's Pacific coast
items.x: Tropical Storm Vance is churning off Mexico’s southwest Pacific coast after a day of gradual weakening but is threatening several western states in that country with heavy rain and possible flash flooding.

items.t: A week after frightening injury, Falcons rookie Daniels comes up big in win over 49ers
items.x: Atlanta Falcons rookie linebacker Kendal Daniels has made a quick turnaround from a frightening injury.

items.t: Yamal misses easy chance for Barcelona and is upstaged by Mbappé as Madrid wins clasico
items.x: Lamine Yamal is so used to scoring that he seemed the most awestruck of all the 60,000-plus at Camp Nou when he missed an easy chance for Barcelona against Real Madrid.

items.t: Ric Flair shares health update amid blood clot treatment, fall
items.x: Wrestling icon Ric Flair shared a health update Saturday after he said he was dealing with a blood clot in his leg and had a fall.

items.t: Kyle Larson extends Chase points lead with first NASCAR win at Talladega after last-lap scramble
items.x: Kyle Larson picked a perfect time for his first NASCAR Cup Series victory at Talladega Superspeedway.

items.t: Kimi Antonelli wins US Grand Prix and tightens his grip on historic F1 title chase
items.x: Kimi Antonelli stormed to an easy ninth win of the season at the United States Grand Prix and further tightened his grip on a Formula 1 season championship that he could win at the next race in Mexico City.

items.t: At least 12 people injured in shooting near a football stadium in Florida
items.x: At least 12 people, including six children, were injured in a shooting near Florida A&M University during homecoming weekend in Tallahassee.

items.t: Trump administration unveils seafood strategy, proposes voluntary U.S. labels
items.x: The Trump administration unveiled a voluntary seafood label and more than $5 billion in loan guarantees to support U.S. fish processors and fishermen.

items.t: More flooding in Four Corners region after storms bring heavy rain and at least one tornado
items.x: A rain-soaked swath of the Southwest U.S. has endured additional flooding after days of rain forced evacuations and water rescues.

items.t: Man United humbled by Bournemouth to leave Carrick's job under threat, Liverpool beats Brighton
items.x: The crisis at Manchester United has deepened with a 3-0 home loss to Bournemouth in the Premier League as under-pressure manager Michael Carrick’s bold call to drop captain Bruno Fernandes failed to pay off.

items.t: Venezuela's opposition leader Machado returns after months in exile, as doubts over democracy deepen
items.x: Nobel laureate María Corina Machado has reappeared in Venezuela for the first time since December.

items.t: A game that won't count, but could pay off: Duke-Kansas brings high stakes to Allen Fieldhouse
items.x: Duke and Kansas faced off in a rare on-campus basketball matchup on Sunday.

items.t: NFL and players' union working together to review the handling of Jalen Hurts' blood clot diagnosis

items.t: Trump escalates anti-Muslim attacks against El-Sayed in Michigan, drawing Arab American rebuke
